coarse_storage.policy: All 524288 original leaf constants are exactly representable in binary32. Only storage changes; splits, tree addition order, scale and bias are unchanged.

octave_expert.features: For lower then upper note: short raw45, long raw45, short then long harmonic-log differences (h1-h2,h3-h2,h5-h4,h7-h6), then long neighboring semitone evidence [0,8,16,22] below and above. No absolute pitch coordinates or extra FFT.
octave_expert.candidate_selection: First 128 trees rank P(any note) over 12 pairs; remaining 640 trees on four pairs; retain their eight notes.
octave_expert.fine_localization: First 32 trees of the existing five-cell model supply relative fine-cell logits. The maximum cell is recentered to the octave expert marginal confidence; it does not change note presence. Other notes retain all 128 fine-model trees.

stages.source: 160 natural train songs, excluding six fixed calibration identities
Natural training plus 48 train-song bass-only half-speed resampling; accompaniment unchanged
Previous stage corpus plus 580 original synthetic clips
Previous stage corpus plus 288 independently seeded lower-only, upper-only and octave-dyad clips

training.validity: Both notes must be certain and mixture AC RMS at least -96 dBFS; no validation, calibration, regression or test identities fitted.
training.bass_augmentation: Exact 2:1 polyphase resampling of rendered bass stems; duration cropped, original accompaniment retained. MIDI time mapped by factor two and pitch by minus twelve, with boundary/bend/audibility uncertainty.

ground_truth.audit: Six additional bass patches were verified with three low and three MIDI>=60 isolated rendered notes per patch. Spectral fundamental, odd harmonics and period/double-period correlation agree on minus twelve semitones, including local scarbee_jay_bass_slap_both.nkm.
ground_truth.baseline_policy: Rebuild per-stem MIDI union, bend masks and rendered audibility for both old and new detectors using identical GT3 labels.

runtime_decision.development_selection: Development validation and previously exposed regression identities only. Preserve full-range and C3-B5 F1 while improving C1 F1, recall and octave-up error; compare candidate counts and measured CPU.

fresh_test.engine: Production SIMD WASM, mono reference PCM duplicated to stereo
fresh_test.selection_policy: Content-independent UUID-hash reservation from 81 remaining official-test identities; all 70 previously exposed identities excluded. Candidate weights, runtime configuration and WASM fixed before opening test audio, labels or predictions. No test-driven tuning.

runtime_cost.scope: Paced headless Node process, real train audio, DSP, telemetry and driver. UI and other processes excluded. Windows CPU-time quantization and host scheduling cause run-to-run variation.
runtime_cost.conclusion: Improved independent F1 and smaller model storage within the CPU budget; not CPU dominance over the preceding runtime. Measured average CPU rises from 7.94 to 8.66 percent of one logical CPU.

limitations: Fresh-test C1 recall remains 40.8%; C1 precision decreases from 95.9% to 73.4% as more low notes are recovered.

The optional historical native --quality-report failures on missing-fundamental/adjacent/moving-voice examples are reproduced with identical TP/FP/FN in baseline WASM; these are pre-existing limitations.
GT3 covers exact locally audited patches only; unknown patches retain their stored MIDI pitch. The unchanged broad detector was trained on GT2.

model_training_design: One shared depth-seven numeric GBDT; aligned causal 85/341 ms windows, strictly-past residuals, cross-pitch evidence and fixed reference coordinates.
display_prior_policy: Fixed historical reference retained for like-for-like confidence comparison; not the new training prevalence.
training_policy: 2 windows per source; every 3th main frame with the original modulo-three phase; every third original synthetic frame; 22 selected steady frames per added acoustic clip; all unambiguous pitches; unit weights.
gpu_reproducibility: Exact saved model and exported margins are identified by hash; GPU retraining is not bit-deterministic.
historical_metric_ground_truth: The original broad model and its historical validation below used GT2. GT3 adds six locally verified bass patch corrections; GT2 metrics are provisional and cannot be compared with GT3. The broad model weights remain unchanged; the new C1-B2 expert and all current runtime comparisons use GT3.
